comparator.name: Communicatiewetenschap
comparator.sourceNotes: The official current study-programme page publishes a complete 180-EC curriculum: 60 EC in each year. Years 1 and 2 comprise communication domains, statistics and research methods, an internship and communication advice. Year 3 comprises 30 EC of elective space, an 18-EC graduation project and 12 EC of communication-science topics. The graduation project requires one of four directions; Corporate Communicatie is selected by the neutral first-listed rule.

components.name: Keuzeruimte
components.note: Genuine elective space; no specific minor or courses are invented.

components.name: Gebonden keuze: Afstudeerproject — Corporate Communicatie
components.note: Corporate Communicatie is selected by the neutral first-listed route rule.

components.name: Gebonden keuze: Topics
components.note: Two communication-science topics chosen from the published bound-choice space.

comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The normalized target names the Dutch Communication Science programme and does not privilege one graduation-project direction. Corporate Communicatie is the first option listed on the official programme page, so it is selected before comparison with UCR.

It implements the explicit academic basis “Communication theory, media, persuasion and effects on people and society” and “Corporate, entertainment, persuasive and political communication domains”.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest match owns the programme-defining communication-science, media-effects and empirical-research interests. Persuasion/marketing/health and political communication/journalism are the two strongest coherent remaining directions and yield feasible, substantively distinct programmes. Entertainment and global/intercultural communication remain coherent candidates but cannot be added after the three-alternative maximum is reached.

notes.text: UvA provides a dedicated Communication Science curriculum with a sequenced methods spine, internship, advice course and 18-EC graduation project. UCR can combine rhetoric, media, politics, behavioural science and empirical methods, but does not reproduce that professional and disciplinary structure.

The selected UvA target is the Dutch-taught Communicatiewetenschap track; UCR is English-taught. Global Communication Science is a distinct English track and is not substituted for the normalized target.
